lc_person: Philip Kevin Goff (born 1964), scholar of American religious history at Indiana University Indianapolis; co-editor of Themes in Religion and American Culture (2004).
item_person: Philip Goff (born 1978), Durham University philosopher of mind and consciousness associated with panpsychism; the item also contains identifiers and occupations belonging to the LC scholar.

evidence.says: Heading: Goff, Philip, 1964-. Sources identify Themes in religion and American culture (2004) and publisher information dated March 30, 2004 naming Philip Kevin Goff and giving birth year 1964. The record links to Q112457426.

The 2004 volume is edited by Philip Goff and Paul Harvey. Goff is identified as a religious studies and American studies scholar at Indiana University-Purdue University Indianapolis, writing on American religious history.
The graph's exact Open Library author ID names Philip Goff and gives birth year 1964.
Works attached to this author include The Blackwell Companion to Religion in America and The Columbia Documentary History of Religion in America since 1945.

Publisher identifies Philip Goff as editor of The Blackwell Companion to Religion in America and an Indiana University-Purdue University Indianapolis scholar. His biography also names Themes in Religion and American Culture and The Columbia Documentary History of Religion in America Since 1945, connecting the Open Library works to the LC book.

Institutional profile identifies Philip Goff as professor of American Studies and History, with academic interests in American religious history, and lists the 2004 Themes volume and the Columbia documentary history among his publications.

Live entity data requested for Q112457426 resolves to Q108304406. The returned item describes the philosopher of mind, gives birth year 1978, and nevertheless carries P244 n2004095975 and VIAF 54430399, along with philosopher, theologian and historian occupations.
Live page explicitly displays a redirect from Q112457426 to Q108304406, whose description identifies the philosopher associated with panpsychism.

Durham University identifies Professor Philip Goff in its Department of Philosophy and describes his research on consciousness and panpsychism, distinguishing him from the Indiana University historian.

notes: The birth mismatch reflects two namesakes and a conflated Wikidata item, rather than a correction to the LC scholar's birth year. The supported year above is for the LC person. LC's linked Q112457426 currently redirects to the disputed item, so it is not a usable separate replacement; no distinct current QID was verified.
